parts.text: Marcel and Beatrice are competing to see who can eat the most fruit rolls, so they spread out as many as they can.
Unfortunately, someone made the mistake that Beatrice's roll was two rolls wide and 24 rolls long while Marcel's roll was three rolls wide.
If they all ate the full amount, with an average of 45 rolls each, how long was Marcel's pile ?

parts.text: A wooden bridge can carry no more than 5000 pounds.
A delivery truck filled with identical boxes, each weighing 15 pounds, will pass over the bridge.
The combined weight of the driver and the empty truck is 3800 pounds.
What is the maximum number of boxes which can be loaded onto the truck while not exceeding the bridge's weight limit?

parts.text: Two sisters, Elizabeth and Margareth, bought beads.
Elizabeth bought 1 pack of red and 2 packs of clear beads, while Margareth bought 3 packs of blue and 4 packs of red beads.
Later, Elizabeth gave away half of her clear beads to a friend.
How many more beads do one sister have than the other, if each pack of beads contains 20 pieces of beads?
